content.comment_body: Hello, Please check the attached image. I am wondering how to automatically reset the network input value back to zero. I prefer not to send another SMS command, such as password;[product_name]=[article_no],0,BIT, just to set the value to 0. My goal is for the value to remain at 1 for around 10 seconds and then automatically switch back to 0.
Please refer to the attached screenshot.
That solution is straightforward and works well. Thank you.

analysis.insight_summary: A user wanted to automate resetting a [product_name] network input value to zero after a specific time, without needing manual actions like SMS commands. Another user shared a solution using a screenshot, which was confirmed as effective and user-friendly by the original poster, showing the workaround met the usability need.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is looking for an automated, simple way to reset a network input value after a set period, minimizing manual or repeated external interactions.
